title: Issues with the app
body: I really like the concept of the app and even bought a subscription, but after a few days, I’ve been quite disappointed. The voice feature constantly lags or cuts out parts of the AI’s responses, and sometimes it switches between two different voices or produces duplicated and distorted audio. This makes conversations very difficult to follow. I mainly subscribed to use the voice option instead of typing, so I really hope these issues are fixed soon.
author: Virag1107
